_about: Every word of the site, in every language. build_site.py (in the life repo) writes one static page per language from it: the default language at the site root, every other under /<code>/. To add a language: add it to "languages" (ordered by the Latin transliteration of its own name, as Wikipedia does), add a block under "strings", and rebuild. A missing key falls back to English.
